g.title: body_stores
g.text: • call to non-param-safe fn with param arg → unsafe

g.title: walk_outward
g.text: • assign to OUTER binding with heap val → unsafe
• push/put: skip target (arg0), check val args
• non-tail call to unknown callee → unsafe

g.title: body_escapes
g.text: • mutating prim with non-imm arg → unsafe

g.title: body_outward
g.text: • mutating prim to NON-LOCAL target → unsafe
(NO arg check — args are return values)
